'''Hak Soo Kim Anti-Revolution''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Hak Soo Kim]]
* '''Published:''' July 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' Anti-Revolution
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH Anti-Revolution Kim DS 1996 Designs.txt |Download]]
